interactions.note: The epitope-specific mAb A6.2 neutralized murine norovirus MNV-1. Neutralization escape mutants were generated by serial passage of the virus in RAW 264.7 cells with antibody. Single point mutations V378F, D385G and L386F in the capsid protein were the dominant mutants selected that allowed escape from neutralization by the mAb.The mutations are in the E'F' loop of the MNV-1 P domain. Additional viruses engineered with E'F' loop mutation A382K, A382P or A382R also escaped neutralization. Modeling of mAb A6.2 to bound to MNV-1 suggests that L386F may be a conformational escape mutation in that it stabilizes a conformation that is not recognized by the antibody and V378F may disrupt the E'F loop structure to prevent mAb A6.2 binding.
